title: Connect apps
subOwner: An app you connect is on for every agent in the company, and they only read from it. Anything that publishes, spends or messages a customer is handed to you, whatever the app.
subOther: Connecting apps and choosing which agents use them is done by the Owner only.
emptyHint: Try another name in Arabic or English, like “كانفا” or Notion.
signInLine: You sign in through {0}’s own window. The password never passes through us.
everyAgent: For now, every agent in the company can use it.
disconnectAsk: Disconnect {0}? Your agents won’t be able to reach it until you connect it again.

waiting: Finish signing in to {0} in its window.
